biography.value:
Fawful's Forces packet sheet — Countess Chortlebrass. Built by tools/build-forge-packets.py from the NPC Forge roster data/forge/fawfuls-forces.json (entry countess-chortlebrass): Large humanoid (Beanish), Neutral Evil; CR 7 (proficiency +3, to hit +6 with STR); AC 16 (throne plating), hit points 127 (15d10+45), speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft.. A GM scene kit for the Fawful's Forces article's present (1040 BF), not a filed event; the faction article stays the authority.

Fawful's headmistress of helms — the Beanish noblewoman who runs the vats under Peach's Castle and decides which prisoners come out as thralls. The Countess took to the Fury Meter's logic better than anyone on the staff: she does not fight, she assigns, and the crown she wears is a rack of Hypno-Helms waiting for heads. The walking throne is her own commission; she has not touched the floor of the castle since the occupation began and regards that as a courtesy to the floor.

As a boss she is a controller first and a brawler second. The barrage puts helms on the party; the decree turns a party member for a moment; the reconstitution eats the wreckage of every construct the party has already killed. Kill the helms, keep the wrecks away from her, and knock the throne's legs out (40 hit points and under) and she is suddenly a thin woman in a chair. She does not cackle when she loses. She writes names down.

Role: controller boss · tier: lieutenant · folder: Fawful's Furious Freaks / Lieutenants of Fury.

Art

Token plate portraits/fawfuls-forces/countess-chortlebrass.png — NPC Forge render, seed 410012, cut from a flat #FF00FF field. Prompt: Clean cel-shaded cartoon character art in the style of Mario & Luigi RPG concept art, bold dark outlines, flat colours, simple shading. A tall thin lime-green Beanish noblewoman with a long face, half-lidded eyes and a cackling grin, wearing a towering brass crown built from small swirl-visor helmets and a long emerald green gown embroidered with gears, holding a swirl-lens lorgnette, seated on a walking mechanical throne with four brass claw legs, brass pipes and a glowing green boiler behind the seat. Full body, whole figure visible, three-quarter view, centred, isolated on a plain flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF), no floor, no ground shadow, no text, no border.

languages.custom: Beanish; telepathy 120 ft. with helm-bound creatures

description.value: The Countess makes two Throne Claw attacks, or one Throne Claw attack and uses Fawful's Decree.
Melee Weapon Attack: reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 2d10 + 3 slashing damage.

The Countess fixes one creature she can see within 60 feet that can hear her with the lorgnette. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by her until the end of her next turn; while charmed this way it immediately uses its reaction to move up to its speed and make one weapon attack against a creature of her choice. A creature that succeeds is immune to her Decree for 24 hours.

Recharge 5–6. The crown flings helms. Up to three creatures she can see within 30 feet must each succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage as a Hypno-Helm lands on them: place a Hypno-Helm (this packet) attached to each creature that failed; it has latched on and the creature must make the helm's DC 13 Wisdom saving throw against Fawful's Voice at once. Helms that miss land in an empty space within 5 feet of their target and act on the Countess's initiative.

The throne rears and slams down. Each creature within 10 feet of the Countess must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d8 bludgeoning damage and falling prone on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Recharge 6. The Countess laughs and every helm in the room laughs with her. Each creature within 30 feet that can hear her must make a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw, taking 4d6 psychic damage and losing its reaction until the end of its next turn on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. Constructs and helm-bound creatures are unaffected.
Bonus action, 3/Day. The throne's boiler eats a destroyed Fawful construct within 30 feet (the wreck is consumed). The Countess regains 15 hit points and her Helm Barrage recharges.
Legendary action (1). The throne scuttles up to 15 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
Legendary action (1). The Countess makes one Throne Claw attack.
Legendary action (2). The Countess uses Fawful's Decree.

The Countess's crown is built of Hypno-Helms and her mind is her own; she can't be charmed, and any creature charmed by a Hypno-Helm within 120 feet of her is charmed by her too and obeys her telepathic orders over the helm's.

The Countess rides a walking mechanical throne; the statblock is the pair. She can't be knocked prone while the throne stands, and the throne lets her climb. When she is reduced to 40 hit points or fewer the throne's legs buckle: her speed drops to 10 feet and she loses Throne Stomp and the Scuttle legendary action.
If the Countess fails a saving throw, she can choose to succeed instead.
